sections.text: مقدمة

This document outlines the major maintenance procedures P1, which must be 
carried out every five years as indicated by Y5 in the title 
block

The pump function is to cool the outlet 
steam from LP turbine to convert the steam to 
condensate water, and also to cool the closed cooling water for accessories

The first draft initiated and tested by eng. Raafat 
Abd Alla, reviewed by eng. Samy Kamal general director, مُراجع 
by eng. 
عبوده البنا 
EDEPC inspection and quality control 
engineer, and approved by eng. Moukhtar Mady head sector of Ataka PS

تم قبول هذه الوثيقة من قبل المهندس. Samir Abdel Gilel: 
EDEPC 
inspection and 
quality control
general director and MPIS coordinator, and certified by accountant Mahmoud 
Mohamed Soliman EDEPC admin. & financial inspection, quality control general 
director and supervisor of inspection & quality control's head sector.
احتياطات السلامة

يجب إصدار تصريح عمل، والصيانة المؤهلة 
 يجب أن يحمل الموظفون فئة السلامة المناسبة.
مطلوب سياج أمان مع علامات تحذير تحيط بمنطقة العمل.

Wear your safety equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes, breathing mask, safety glass .. 
 etc.
Isolate the circuit breaker of the pump motor.
Disconnect electric terminals of the pump motor.
The pump must be isolated mechanically by closing delivery and suction valves.
Be sure pump must be completely drainage.

sections.text: التفكيك
Remove the feed lines of lubrication water and oil cooling for pump
Dismantle the bolts of the upper carden coupling and lift the motor
Dismantling the carden coupling from pump side
Drain the dearing housing from oil
Dismantle the motor base

Remove 
 the coupling from the pump shaft and it's key

Dismantle the thrust bearing (cover, deflector, rings, brace ring, ball 
 bearing, springs, cooling coil)
Dismantle the bolts between the discharge elbow and discharge line.
Lift the pump and put it in the work place.
Dismantle the suction element.
Check the clearance between suction element and impeller.
Remove the impeller after remove the impeller nose.
Remove the bowl.
Remove the stuffing box gland, lantern ring and gland cover.
Dismantle the discharge elbow.
Dismantle the lower journal bearing.
